OrphanedCommitJson.description: One commit left unreachable by a reset, or by switching away from a detached `HEAD`.

branch.description: Branch `HEAD` is on after the switch, or JSON `null` when detached.

hooks_run.description: Hooks that ran after the switch (`post-checkout` when installed).

path_collisions.description: Index paths that collided during checkout on a case-insensitive filesystem.

stranded_commits.description: Newest-first commits only the previous detached `HEAD` reached (capped at 20).

stranded_total.description: Total commits left behind; may exceed `stranded_commits` when truncated. Advisory count; without a commit-graph, severe clock skew can make it inaccurate.
